title: File:St Johns River swamp drainage.jpg
art: Tony Santana, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
desc: Drainage ditches in the upper St. Johns River basin in Indian River County or Brevard County, Florida, USA. The drainage area was constructed by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to drain the wetlands and protect nearby cities from flooding.

title: File:Tropical Storm Fay causes 20 inches of flooding near Geneva, Florida.jpg
desc: Geneva, FL, August 28, 2008 -- Tropical Storm Fay dumped 20 inches of water along the coast and it is still draining to this location along the St. John's River. FEMA PA Funds may help state and local government recover cost of road and other repair.

title: File:Tropical Storm Fay, Florida, August 25, 2008.jpg
art: NASA image courtesy the MODIS Rapid Response Team at NASA GSFC.
desc: The swollen St. Johns River in central Florida paints a wide black ribbon down the bright green plant-covered landscape in this satellite image taken during Tropical Storm Fay. Tiny clouds, pale blue and white in this type of image, dot the skies. Flooding around Lake Okeechobee can also be seen.
